plan.title: Withdraw live RFQ with two bids

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ with two submitted bids without searching for another event.
Enable the configuration that exposes the Withdraw Project action.
Enable eRFX projects required by the prepared RFQ scenario.
Withdraw the entire live project and provide the required withdrawal reason.
Assert Procol records the project as withdrawn.
Open the project's activity drawer to inspect the withdrawal audit entry.
Assert the withdrawal reason appears in Order Activity.
Return to the buyer's Responses view to check that the two bid responses remain visible.
Assert both submitted vendor responses remain present after withdrawal.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier-portal session to inspect the withdrawn event from the vendor side.
Open the prepared event's vendor overview rather than starting a new bid.
Assert the vendor sees the event as withdrawn.
